# Feelspoon

> A recipe organizer for Android. Save a recipe from a link, a photo of a
> recipe card, pasted text or your own notes; cook it hands-free, step by step;
> scale it to your servings.

Made by Shift-9 (https://shift9.dev). Developer of record: Kariim Chiles.
Live on Google Play since 2026. There is no iPhone version.

## What it does

- Save from a link, a photo, a screenshot, pasted text, or a description
- Strips the blog filler: keeps title, ingredients, steps, times and photo
- Cook mode: one step at a time in large text, read aloud, screen kept awake,
  timers built into the steps that need them
- Scale to your servings, in US cups or metric
- Weekly meal plan, turned into a shopping list sorted by aisle
- Tags, search, bookmarks, and offline use

## What it costs

- Free: unlimited saved recipes, cook mode, scaling, meal plan and shopping
  list. No card, no trial period.
- Premium: unlimited AI recipe captures. $4.99 per month or $39.99 per year
  ($3.33 a month billed yearly). Purchased through Google Play.

## Honest limits

- Android only. No iOS build exists yet.
- Launched 2026, so there is no long review history to read.
- It is a recipe organizer, not a social network, a grocery service, or an
  appliance companion.
